st-01-c1.text: Seçkin Demirbaş, Andrew Rechnitzer. Section 8.1 Subsets, in PLP: An introduction to mathematical proof. University of British Columbia, Department of Mathematics.
st-01-c1.quote: The empty set is a subset of every set.
st-01-c1.claim: The empty set ∅ = {} has nothing in it, and it's a subset of every set.
